attempts.origin: Set-Acl succeeded; the script then compared Windows' account-name display of Owner with a SID string and raised MANIFEST_ACL_MISMATCH. Live SID owner and single protected ACE were confirmed separately.

Repeat Set-Acl against the already protected file required unavailable SeSecurityPrivilege. No new ACL state was accepted; script changed to recognize an already compliant ACL without reapplying it. Attempt 3 and independent readback exited 0.
The read used parent cwd, so the relative path did not resolve. Repeated from research-os and confirmed LIVE_READBACK_PASS. This was a read-only setup error.
